subject: Social Media
title: Jonah Berger's STEPPS
description: Learn Jonah Berger's STEPPS in one minute.

hook.text: Why does a $100 cheesesteak go viral but a better restaurant stays unknown? Berger cracked the formula.

buildup.text: STEPPS: Social currency, Triggers, Emotion, Public visibility, Practical value, Stories.

discovery.text: Each element increases sharing probability. Combine several and virality becomes far more likely.

twist.text: But STEPPS isn't a guarantee. You can hit every mark and still fail. The network decides, not the content.

climax.text: Berger found triggers matter most. KitKat paired with coffee breaks—sales surged because coffee is daily.

punchline.text: Great content isn't enough. It needs a trigger.

quiz.question: What does STEPPS stand for in Berger's virality framework?
options: Speed, Timing, Effort, Promotion, Platform, Size
Social currency, Triggers, Emotion, Public, Practical value, Stories
